## Summary

Resume each mounted Massive Cannon's stopped charge clip when that gun fires. Retain its independent stage-clock phase through pause and crossings, then stop again after the 27-frame loop.

```text
gun trigger → retained play episode
  → native clip / cached mock charge pose
  → shared painting and contact geometry
```

Repeated play preserves an active phase. New tanks and forcefield copies start idle. The existing queued shot callback keeps its own timing.

## Evidence

- **Before:** Cached posters are correctly idle, but firing never resumes the attached charge artwork.
  **After:** Native/mock galleries show independent mounts, paused progression, later episodes, empty frame27 and additional charge-particle contact points. The source calls `bullet_mc.play()` before queuing its shot effect.
- Both numeric imports reproduce committed hashes. Formatting, TypeScript, 395 tests/5,344 assertions and production build pass; all 12 focused browser cases and all 35 mock/synthetic-selected cases pass. After the independent dialog-focus repair merged in #9, the combined 38-case mock/synthetic and native Info/charge selection also passes. The native gallery was inspected.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** Artwork

Mounted playback is consumed by shared rendering and contact. Original global event timing and exact rasterization remain documented comparison limits; forcefield recreation after crossing is a separate next checkpoint.
## Summary

Recreate forcefield artwork after an ordinary field crossing, following the source passive Run lifecycle.

```text
ordinary exit → detach wrapper and clear readiness
  → eligible passive Run → fresh mask/splash and clone clocks
jam/stun → defer reconstruction
```

Keep damage debt and recharge counters across reconstruction. Death escape and Apocalypse retain their direct-exit behavior, and live mounted gun clips keep their own phase.

## Evidence

- **Before:** A per-tank cached forcefield wrapper and mask survive ordinary crossings, including when jam/stun should postpone reconstruction.
  **After:** Rule and production-renderer checks cover detached painting, crossing/pause/arrival, delayed rebuilding, fresh clone age, disposal of the previous view and retained live gun identity.
- Decompiled `APassiveForcefield.FinalPartCall`, `Run` and `Setup` establish detach/recreate behavior and unconditional readiness without resetting damage debt. TypeScript and all 402 tests/5,403 assertions pass. Formatting and production build pass; all 38 selected browser checks plus three native forcefield/charge/tank-art checks pass. Native/mock galleries were inspected; mock protection remains a circular approximation.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** Protection

Changes forcefield lifecycle during field transitions. Source display-order readiness changes and exact constructor/stage timing remain documented fidelity work; complete game parity remains unproven.
